text:
luke_customer: Getting a 413 when calling /v1/rerank. Error text is just "Request Entity Too Large". We send a single query + ~500 docs (each ~2-3KB). Was working before, now customer sees immediate 413. payload sample:
```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer KEY' -d '{"query": "...long query...","documents": [ ... 500 long docs ... ] }'```

sara_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the full request body size (bytes) and the exact response body? customer id/account? :thinking:

luke_customer: Response body empty except 413 header. Body size ~1.2MB. Org: acme-ml (acct_789). We tried removing docs and it still fails at ~200 docs.

sara_support: OK thanks. A couple quick checks: which rerank model/version are you calling? are you on Hosted free tier or Dedicated? any experimenting with chunking?

luke_customer: model: rerank-v1 (default). Hosted. We tried batch sizes 100, 200 — 100 sometimes works but score outputs are weird (lots of zeros). Not sure if truncation or tokenization happening.

mike_engineer: From runtime side: rerank input limits are token-based (tokenized query + sum(tokenized docs)). The 413 likely from request payload size before we parse, but the scoring oddities at 100 suggest partial truncation or serialization overflow. Do we have ingress NGinx limit logs for acct_789? katy?

katy_sre: I pulled proxy logs — upstream returned 413 with no detailed JSON. Nginx returned the generic 413 before our app tried to validate tokens. So two issues: (1) request too large at HTTP layer, (2) UX: users get generic 413 not hinting at token limit.

ron_sales: Customer is on Hosted free tier, but they're a trial-heavy AI startup. This is blocking their eval. Any temporary workaround we can offer until UX fix?

sara_support: Workarounds to offer: (a) client-side chunking: send documents in batches and re-rank each batch then merge — sample pseudocode:
```python
batches = chunk(docs, 100)
results = []
for b in batches:
  resp = client.rerank(query, b)
  results.extend(resp.scores)
# merge/normalize per-document scores
```
(b) precompute embeddings and do cosine re-ranking client-side if latency/budget allows.

luke_customer: Can you share a concrete curl example that splits into multiple calls? They want a one-call experience but will accept integration instructions for now.

mike_engineer: Paste this quick example — it streams batches and collects indices: 
```bash
# split docs into files docs-0.json docs-1.json ...
for f in docs-*.json; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d @${f} | jq '.' >> partial_results.json
done
# then merge partial_results.json by mapping back to original doc ids
```
This avoids the 413 since each HTTP body is smaller.

mike_engineer: Long-term ask: runtime should return structured JSON with an explicit code when tokenization total > limit, e.g. `\{"error":"input_tokens_exceeded","limit":65536,"seen":98765\}` not a generic 413. I'll file an eng issue.

katy_sre: Filed ENG-IR-4321 to add explicit error JSON and bump nginx client_max_body_size detection to return helpful message. Also adding an ingress metric to catch heavy POST bodies per org.

sara_support: Action items for support: 1) send luke the batching curl snippet and the KB link: https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/size-limits (temporary doc patch attached) 2) offer to set up a quick demo to help them chunk/merge 3) escalate to eng for UX fix.

ron_sales: Also flag for account team — if they move to Dedicated the ingress limits will be configurable and we can avoid this. I'll reach out to acct team.

luke_customer: Thanks, please send the curl and the KB. If we can get the error message improved it would stop confusion. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-2026-118 for acme-ml (acct_789) — ENG-IR-4321 linked. Assigned to mike_engineer. Estimated ETA for UX patch: next sprint.

sara_support: Sending KB + sample scripts now. If anything else breaks please ping here. :thumbsup:
